reflection.candidate_lesson: When the 30-indicator consensus shows conv=100% SHORT with hist_hr>65% on a pair (EURUSD 66%, AUDUSD 72%), only size up if TradingView external confirmation is non-null — pure internal-only consensus at 75% sizing is where the current regime (CONCENTRATION, verified=False) silently degrades edge.
reflection.mechanism: CONCENTRATION regime means moves are narrow/fragile and driven by a single theme (AI/tech); broad FX consensus signals get corrupted by cross-asset safe-haven and USD flows that the indicator stack reads as directional conviction but which reverse when the concentrated theme cools — external TV confirmation acts as an orthogonal cross-check that internal indicators cannot provide to themselves.
reflection.testable_rule: if consensus_conv == 1.0 and consensus_hist_hr > 0.65 and tradingview_signals == 0: cap sizing_multiplier at 0.5 instead of 0.75
